name: Ravenpost
tagline: Schedule and publish social posts from your agent
description: Social media scheduling for Cline: list the accounts connected in Ravenpost (Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube, Pinterest and Telegram), upload media and cut an image to each network's canvas, preview a post as each network will render it with a warning for anything a network would reject, then save it as a draft, schedule it, queue it or publish it. Edit or cancel pending posts and read followers and engagement where a network reports them.
